geometry_analysis.surface_profile: Convex reinforcement; surface is disrupted by voids and adhesions.

visual_anomalies.visual_description: A distinct, deep, round hole located immediately at the Start (Left) of the weld bead. It appears to be a gas pocket trapped upon arc ignition.
The End (Right) termination point exhibits a chaotic cluster of voids or a collapsed crater pipe, visibly open to the surface.
Patches of rust-brown, slag-like material adhered along the upper toe and body of the weld, creating a rough surface texture.

surface_state.discoloration: Metallic grey with significant brown oxide/slag patches
